notes.title: Rube Works 2.1.2, Mac Update
notes.notes: New build of Rube Works built using Unity version 2017.4.40f1. Also, longer click ok to tie/untie string.

notes.title: Rube Works version 1.5 (French, Italian) Now Live
notes.notes:
New Features 
• Now includes all text in French and Italian (as well as English, German, Spanish)
• Fixes problem that caused Spanish text to not display
